Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Automatically price new and existing retainer listings.
Description: Automatically price eligible inventory and reprice existing listings one gil below matching competition using Universalis market prices and recent sale history.
Changelog: Adds Auto vendor for eligible carried stacks at a configurable Universalis price. Sniper now follows world, Data Center, or region scope settings, deduplicates 1-gil alerts, and defaults to a 91.0% median threshold. Start listing items refreshes inventory between sales and caps each listing at 99 items.
